# netbox_module_bay_templates (Data Source)

Retrieves all module bay templates from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module_bay_templates" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "module_bay_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_module_bay_templates.example.module_bay_templates[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `module_bay_templates` (Attributes List) The module bay templates found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--module_bay_templates))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.
